name: hero-parallax

frames.best_why: Shows the headline over two tilted rows of photos, the layout at its most characteristic.

tagline: A bold studio headline over rows of tilted photos that slide as you scroll.
summary: A full-width dark hero with a huge white headline and a short paragraph, backed by three rows of large photo cards caught in perspective. Scrolling slides the rows sideways and raises the wall upright.
appearance: A black stage with a large white headline and small paragraph on the left, crossed by rows of big photo cards tilted in perspective. The cards form diagonal bands of city, car and street scenes, each with a small caption at its bottom-left.
behaviour: As the page scrolls, the card rows slide sideways in opposite directions while the whole block rotates upright from a steep tilt and rises into place. Hovering a card lifts it and shows its title.
demo_content: Headline The Ultimate development studio, a studio blurb, and cards titled Moonbeam, Cursor, Rogue and others.
search_phrases: hero with rows of tilted photos
photos that drift in opposite directions
use_when: A studio or product landing page that wants a bold headline backed by a moving wall of work.
avoid_when: Small screens or few images: cards are fixed at 30rem wide and fifteen are expected.
customise: Pass a products array of title, link and thumbnail; row placement, the spring and the fifteen-card layout are fixed.
weight_why: Fifteen large photos with several spring transforms driven by scroll.

a11y.note: Captions and the card lift are mouse-only; links have alt text but no focus styling.

issues: Frames 4, 5 and 6 show long blank black stretches as the component scrolls away.
Card captions only appear on hover, so the photos read as anonymous.
The 300vh height leaves a lot of empty black space below the headline.
polish_why: Striking tilted image wall behind a bold headline; the long scroll leaves blank gaps.
title: Hero Parallax
